about:
CHR Metals, LLC operates from Springfield, Missouri. The company’s founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed.

The shop provides custom metal fabrication, modification, and repair services from its Springfield location. Core processes include TIG and MIG welding, CNC plasma cutting, shearing, and bending. It produces items such as stair rails, catwalks, platforms, ladders, safety cages, dust collection systems, handrails, and architectural sheet metal components. The facility also handles wrought iron gates, fences, and restaurant-grade stainless steel fabrications, along with one-of-a-kind private projects and metal art. Materials worked include stainless steel, aluminum, galvanized steel, carbon steel, and copper.

Customers span industrial, commercial, residential, restaurant, and institutional sectors. Examples include industrial dust collection systems, commercial kitchen stainless steel fabrications, residential copper gutters and roofs, and institutional safety cages and platforms.

The company emphasizes its ability to tackle unusual and one-of-a-kind private projects, offering portable welding and on-site repair services for trailers, equipment, and aluminum boats.
